trigger: Police want to arrest me for someone else's offence
description: What to do if the police try to hold you because of what a relative or friend is accused of.

steps.text: Stay calm and do not resist, even though holding you for another person's act is wrong.
You are presumed innocent and answerable only for your own conduct (s.36(5)).
Say clearly: 'I have not been accused of any offence. On what grounds am I being arrested?' (s.35(3)).
Do not agree to be held 'until the person shows up'. Ask to be released or charged.
You may remain silent until you speak to a lawyer (s.35(2)).
Note the officers' names, numbers, and the station you are taken to.
Call your lawyer or a trusted person now.
